learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be clearly distinguished from genuine uncertainty in the verdict. An 'inconclusive' due to a tool error should not be treated the same as an 'inconclusive' due to ambiguous code.

When a critical file review fails due to a tool error, the audit tool should either retry with a different model or clearly flag the failure as a coverage issue rather than marking the entire package as inconclusive.
